title: Contents Packout & Storage Return Scheduling and Pack-Back Terms
content:
## Terms

1. The job must be in in custody status when the return is scheduled.
2. On tiers that require it, the return is scheduled only once every rebuild contract of the customer at the same loss address is in substantially complete, final invoiced or closed status.
3. A loss address with no rebuild contract needs no such wait.
4. The scheduled return date must be at least the tier's return notice business days after the day the return is scheduled.
5. Business days are Monday through Friday excluding company holidays.
6. Pack-back is billed per box and per furniture item reset at the tier's rates, rounded to the cent, half up; storage stops accruing with the storage period in which the contents are returned, and no period starting after the returned date is billed.

## Retired clauses

- In term 6, the clause "Pack-back is billed per box and per furniture item reset at the tier's rates, rounded to the cent, half up" is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current Contents Packout & Storage basis.
- In term 6, the clause "storage stops accruing with the storage period in which the contents are returned" is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis. The words "no period starting after the returned date is billed" remain in force.

## Conditions for scheduling a return

| Condition | What the records must show |
|---|---|
| Status | the job is in custody when the return is scheduled |
| Rebuild wait (tiers that require it) | every Reconstruction contract of the customer at the same loss address is substantially complete, final invoiced or closed; with no rebuild contract at the address there is no wait |
| Notice | the scheduled return date is at least the tier's return notice business days after the day the return is scheduled |

Which tiers require the rebuild wait, and how many business days of notice each tier requires, are the tier values on the product's pack-back and return terms table.

## Counting notice (hypothetical figures)

Take a hypothetical notice requirement of 4 business days, with no company holiday in the week. A return scheduled on a Monday may be set for the Friday of the same week or later (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday are four business days after the Monday); the Thursday of that week is too early. Saturdays, Sundays and company holidays are never counted.

## Rebuild wait cases

- One rebuild contract at the address, in substantially complete status: the wait is met.
- Two rebuild contracts at the address, one closed and one in construction: the wait is not met, because every contract at the address must be substantially complete, final invoiced or closed.
- No rebuild contract at the address: no wait applies.

superseded_clauses: Pack-back is billed per box and per furniture item reset at the tier's rates, rounded to the cent, half up
storage stops accruing with the storage period in which the contents are returned
